tasks.label: Flash PIDCalibrator UF2
args: set -e; UF2="${workspaceFolder}/build/PIDCalibrator.uf2"; if [ ! -f "$UF2" ]; then echo "UF2 not found: $UF2" >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ ! -d "/Volumes/RPI-RP2" ]; then echo "Pico mass-storage drive not found at /Volumes/RPI-RP2. Hold BOOTSEL, reconnect Pico, then retry." >&2; exit 1; fi; cp "$UF2" "/Volumes/RPI-RP2/"; sync; echo "Flashed $UF2 to /Volumes/RPI-RP2"
